## CSV Viewer

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Preview a CSV/TSV file or pasted text as a table with automatic delimiter, header and column type detection.

```sh
dogubako data csv-view [file] [options]
```

Id `data.csv_view` · MCP `data_csv_view` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: csv, tsv, viewer, table, open csv, preview, spreadsheet

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | positional | file |  | Accepts text/\*, .csv .tsv .txt .json .ndjson .jsonl +4 more. |
| `text` | `--text` | text (multi-line) |  | Or paste CSV. |
| `delimiter` | `--delimiter` | choice | `auto` | One of: `auto` (Auto-detect), `comma` (Comma ,), `tab`, `semicolon` (Semicolon ;), `pipe` (Pipe \|). *Advanced.* |
| `header` | `--header` | choice | `auto` | One of: `auto` (Auto-detect), `yes` (First row is a header), `no` (No header). *Advanced.* |
| `offset` | `--offset` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` | Start at row. |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer 1–500 | `100` | Rows to show. |

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span></div>

## CSV to JSON

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Convert CSV/TSV into a JSON array of objects, an array of arrays or NDJSON, with optional type inference.

```sh

```

Id `data.csv_to_json` · MCP `data_csv_to_json` · Output: text (`application/json`) · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: csv to json, tsv to json, convert, ndjson, json lines

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `text` | `--text` | text (multi-line) |  | Or paste CSV. |

## Spreadsheet Viewer & Export

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span></div>

Open Excel (xlsx, xls, xlsb) and OpenDocument (ods) spreadsheets: list sheets, preview a sheet and export it as CSV or JSON.

```sh
dogubako data spreadsheet <file> [options]
```

Id `data.spreadsheet` · MCP `data_spreadsheet` · Output: structured data · Timeout 5 min

Also found by: excel, xlsx, xls, ods, spreadsheet, sheet, xlsx to csv, excel to json

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` *(required)* | positional | file |  | Spreadsheet. Accepts .xlsx .xlsm .xls .xlsb .ods. |
| `sheet` | `--sheet` | text |  | Sheet name (blank = first). |
| `action` | `--action` | choice | `preview` | One of: `preview`, `csv` (Export as CSV), `json` (Export as JSON), `all_csv` (Export every sheet as CSV). |
| `header` | `--header` | boolean | `true` | First row is a header. |
| `offset` | `--offset` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` | Start at row. Only used when `action` is `preview`. |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer 1–500 | `100` | Rows to show. Only used when `action` is `preview`. |

## Transform Columns

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span></div>

Rename, drop, reorder, split, merge, change case, trim or find-and-replace in CSV columns, or add a row index.

```sh

```

Also found by: csv, columns, rename, drop, reorder, split column, merge columns, transform

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | positional | file |  | Accepts text/\*, .csv .tsv .txt .json .ndjson .jsonl +4 more. |
| `text` | `--text` | text (multi-line) |  | Or paste CSV. |

| `operation` | `--operation` | choice | `rename` | One of: `rename`, `drop` (Drop columns), `select` (Keep / reorder columns), `split` (Split a column), `merge` (Merge columns), `upper` (UPPERCASE values), `lower` (lowercase values), `title` (Title Case values), `trim` (Trim values), `replace` (Find & replace in values), `index` (Add row number column). |
